I've replied to Dana in our direct message: Amendment No. 1 at Quarrendon Freight Lines is for 185 seats.

That number comes from #north-team, a channel she's in. On 20 Aug 2025 she posted 180 seats, then corrected it to 185 a few minutes later. I couldn't find the signed amendment in the shared files, so I suggested she check 185 against the signed copy before it goes in the QBR deck.

Seat counts are operational facts, not finance figures, so no approval was needed.
